The original three standalone tiles contain no diagram, while verification steps 2.1, 4.1 and 4.2 provide exact geometric data for one. This is an authorized explanatory addition rather than a claim that the original proof or rendering is invalid.
findings.action: Added a fenced TikZ parameter-domain schematic and its conventions in the final Remarks section.

correction: Added aligned parameter rectangles R1 and R2, colored closed overlap preimages K1 and K2/h(K2), shared increasing t axis, and interior-only normal comparisons. Original title, mathematical carrier and all frontmatter are byte-identical; only Remarks was appended.

diagram_math_checks.check: At diagram horizontal coordinate x, t=-pi/6+x*pi/3. R1 spans x=0..4, hence [-pi/6,7pi/6]; R2 spans x=3..7, hence [5pi/6,13pi/6]. Both vertical spans have unit height representing s in [-1/2,1/2], with rows displaced only for display.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Example definition of R1,R2 and verification step 2.1.

diagram_math_checks.check: The orange strips x=3..4 in both rows give t in [5pi/6,7pi/6] and the full s interval. Their corresponding parameters are identical. The label N1=N2 applies only to interiors, as stated explicitly in the prose.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification steps 2.1 and 4.1; local unit-normal definition uses the parametrization cross product on its interior.

diagram_math_checks.check: The blue strip x=0..1 gives [-pi/6,pi/6]; the blue strip x=6..7 gives [11pi/6,13pi/6]. h(t,s)=(t+2pi,-s) maps the first closed rectangle bijectively onto the second, reverses s, and maps interiors to interiors. Psi2 composed with h equals Psi1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification steps 1.1, 2.1 and 4.2; no identity-on-s is asserted by horizontal alignment.

diagram_math_checks.check: On K1 interiors, identical restrictions give identical ordered partial derivatives and induced normals. On K2 interiors, Dh has determinant -1; equivalently the explicit area-vector formula of step 3.1 changes sign under h. Thus the same common image point has N1=-N2 for the shifted pair, exactly as labelled. No boundary normal or compatible finite patch presentation is asserted.
